name: MFGE 5130
title: Manufacturing Automation and Industry 4.0
description: Theory of automation as related to manufacturing and design integration, including hardware, software, and algorithm issues involved in fast and flexible product development cycles. Topics cover automated manufacturing systems, CAD-CAM and integration, programming and simulation, robotics, reverse engineering virtual reality, and sensor fusion for machine tool monitoring. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
